shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Wide front-seat car two-shot through windshield/side glass of 1994 sedan cruising Los Angeles at 7:22 AM; Hooman drives right, Damon passenger left.
shots.dialogue: Nobody forced everybody to go fifty-fifty on Darren's Encino oysters, dood! My leather seats are screaming!
shots.tts: Nobody forced everybody to go fifty-fifty on Darren's Encino oysters, dood! My leather seats are screaming!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: 50mm car passenger close-up on Damon in black suit and dark-teal Wayfarers holding his stomach stiffly against the seatbelt.
shots.dialogue: My Freestyle Libre hit two-ten in Culver City. Those oysters moved straight to felony indictment.
shots.tts: [dry, gravelly deadpan endurance under severe abdominal pressure] My Freestyle Libre hit two-ten in Culver City. Those oysters moved straight to felony indictment.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Tight 50mm driver close-up on Hooman glaring sideways through sunlight flashing across the sedan steering wheel.

shots.tts: You think Cabo escrow money and the last loperamide strip vanish at four AM by accident, huuuuh?

shots.dialogue: They took the golden briefcase and your Magic Cone. They left us behind on Ventura Boulevard.
shots.tts: [clipped, icy criminal-defense attorney gravity] They took the golden briefcase and your Magic Cone. They left us behind on Ventura Boulevard.

shots.speaker: hooman

shots.dialogue: Clench your core, baba! Somebody leaks brownie batter on cream leather, detailing splits fifty-fifty!
shots.tts: Clench your core, baba! Somebody leaks brownie batter on cream leather, detailing splits fifty-fifty!

shots.dialogue: Relax. I double-parked across a hydrant with no brakes. Grab the case in two minutes.
shots.tts: [fast, blunt, no-patience deadpan warning] Relax. I double-parked across a hydrant with no brakes. Grab the case in two minutes.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: 50mm medium two-shot outside chipped Apartment 49 olive door under buzzing bare bulb; Hooman smooths his lapels.

shots.tts: [flat gravelly stoicism, fighting a violent cramp] I survived L.A. County jail—jail, never prison—on warm yogurt. Knock twice, clear the porcelain.
